responsibility: This file implements GCC’s vec_perm_indices abstraction for canonicalizing and analyzing vector permutation selectors used by vector operations such as VEC_PERM_EXPR. It builds canonical encodings from raw permutation builders, supports expansion and shrinking by element factor, rotation of input vectors, series/range analysis, and conversion to and from tree and RTL constant vectors, making permutation masks comparable across vector shapes and compiler representations.
same_name_distinction: Provides the operational logic for canonicalizing and transforming permutation masks, including expansion/shrinking, range/series analysis, and conversions to TREE and RTL forms, plus selftests. The header only declares the vec_perm_indices class and basic inline accessors.
